items.item_text: Bachelor's degree in related area and / or equivalent experience / training. (Required)
Prior experience drafting from templates, redlining, and analyzing specific contracting assignments such as professional services agreements, partnership agreements, and licensing agreements.
Prior experience using project management software and/or contract management software.
Prior experience using Microsoft Word and Adobe Acrobat for contract drafting and mark-ups.

The Contract & Program Administrator supports a number of Lawrence Hall of Science programs, including a wide variety of instructional materials products, educational outreach programs, and professional services. This position plays a key customer interfacing role by gathering information from internal and external stakeholders, drafting and issuing standard contracts, and overseeing contract systems and processes.
Liaises with both internal stakeholders and customers to determine contract details, scope of work information details, and other information critical to program/service booking and contracting.
Reviews contract requests and selects appropriate contracting method based on departmental needs.
Prepares, compares, redlines, and/or routes for signature, standard contract documents.
Uses project management software and contract management software to track contracts from information collection to completion.
Manages communications and processes related to program and service bookings and contracting.
Leads in-house training sessions on contracting processes.
Other contract and program administration duties as assigned.
Working knowledge and understanding of contracting processes and best practices.
Strong written, verbal and professional interpersonal communications skills; and ability to deal effectively with broad and diverse constituencies.
Strong customer service orientation and skills.
